question: Why didn’t Petelgeuse possess ‘Juli’, knowing he was a spirit arts user and nearby? It seems like possessing Juli would give him a better improvement in fighting strength.
answer: He can’t jump into a spirit arts user that already has a contract. I thought I had written about this around the time of the battle against Petelgeuse, but if I forgot, sorry about that. As a result, if Subaru had a contract with Beako, Petelgeuse would have been completely powerless.
